g.text: 72 supplied samples / 17 features; uncorrected Bray-Curtis PCoA. Equal x/y units; marginal boxes share scatter limits.
38 negative eigenvalues (14.5% of absolute eigenvalue sum); axis percentages use the original signed-sum denominator.
Letters: original axis-wise ANOVA/Tukey; shared letters mean no detected difference at 0.05. PERMANOVA: 999 free permutations, seed fixed.
Singleton group(s): SCNC_P; no within-group distribution estimate. Sampling design and dispersion assumptions are unverified.
